name: Surface Noise via Slice-Projection Theorem
aliases: Slice-Projection Theorem Application for Surface Noise
definition: A method to obtain band-pass noise on a surface from band-pass solid noise by exploiting the slice-projection theorem, which states that slicing in one domain corresponds to projection or integration in the other.
summary: Surface Noise via Slice-Projection Theorem generates band-pass noise on curved surfaces by integrating 3D noise along surface normals, avoiding the low-frequency drift and distortions of direct sampling.
